# Southern Iron Equipment

Southern Iron Equipment is southern Alberta and southeast British Columbia's direct marketplace for used and new heavy equipment. Equipment is staged at our Lethbridge yard, 1065 - 36th Street North, Lethbridge, AB T1H 6L5.

## What we sell
Used and new forklifts, telehandlers, excavators, skid steers, backhoe loaders, compact track loaders, teletrucks, and aerial work platforms. Brands include JCB, Tailift, AUSA, Starke, LMH, Hyundai, Hyster, Caterpillar, John Deere, Merlo, Yale and Toyota.

## Service area
We deliver and serve: Lethbridge, Medicine Hat, Claresholm, Taber, Fort Macleod, Pincher Creek, Cardston, Brooks (Alberta); plus Cranbrook, Fernie, Sparwood, Nelson and the wider Kootenay region (British Columbia).

## Contact
- Phone / Text: 587-486-2277

- Address: 1065 - 36th Street North, Lethbridge, AB T1H 6L5

## Pricing
Pricing is provided direct on request, not displayed on the website. Pricing on Facebook, Facebook Marketplace, and Kijiji is current and authoritative.

There are currently 82 units in stock across categories: Forklifts (52), Compact Track Loaders (8), Telehandlers (7), Rough Terrain Forklifts (5), Excavators (4), Backhoe Loaders (4), Loaders (3), Teletrucks (1), Aerial Work Platforms (1).
